notes.title: Bug Fix #1
notes.content:
- Fixed issues relating to the powerup case (for example, not giving out more powerups when enemy and/or player has more than 4)
- Fixed exiting to menu not working as intended, forcing players to use resume for it to happen 
- Fixed bug where damage is dealt as 2 when it shouldn't
- Fixed bug where the host can't use double down
- Fixed some issues with AI's behaviour when using powerups or deciding to hit
